connector.name: Gs1belu Mpm Download
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial MCP tool surface for GS1 Belgium & Luxembourg's My Product Manager Download API (v17).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gs1belu-mpm-download-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wimsuenens account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
